newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Several tech stock options busy.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Several tech stock options busy.

text.p: Options on several technology stocks remained actively traded Tuesday as the underlying shares continued to trade in wide ranges, traders said.
Among the highlights, 3Com Corp options, traded at the Pacific Stock Exchange, were among the most active as the shares fell sharply after rebounding in early trade.
In afternoon activity, the stock was down 2-3/4 at 62 after climbing to 68-3/4 earlier. Turnover was again heavy at roughly 18.4 million shares.
The stock has dropped from around 73 in three trading sessions.
Among the options, the February 70 put was most active, with more than 6,630 contracts changing hands. The option, which rose 2-1/8 to 8-5/8, had open interest of 4,286.
The February 65 put traded about 5,200 contracts, the February 70 call traded 4,965 and the February 65 call traded 2,555.
Options on shares of International Business Machines Corp also were busy as the stock staged a solid rebound after a week of heavy selling.
IBM shares were ahead 5-1/4 at 151 on 6.9 million shares in consolidated trading.
The company announced a two-for-one stock split.
One broker said investors continued to go long IBM calls, expecting the stock split news to fuel a continued recovery in the underlying shares.
The most active IBM options were the February 160 and 155 calls, with turnover of about 6,615 and 6,480 contracts, respectively.
Among IBM puts, the February 145 traded 3,940 contracts and the February 140 traded about 3,810. ((--G. Crawford, 312 408 8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com))
